edges.why: r1 makes tag:triaged, which r2 waits for
r4 makes tag:pong, which r5 waits for
r5 removes tag:ping, which r4 waits for

findings.text: undoes what r4 waits for. This looks like a cycle and is not one: a `when` rule fires at most ONCE per thing, ever. The loop guard and recurrence are the same knob.

r1 when kind:task,tag:urgent do tag add=triaged   (fired 1x)

r4 when tag:ping do tag add=pong   (fired 1x)

r6 when tag:ghost do move into=Nowhere   (fired 0x)
r7 when tag:blue do tag add=seen   (fired 0x)
r8 when due<2026-09-18 do tag add=overdue   (fired 1x)
r9 when kind:task,-tag:urgent do tag add=someday   (fired 2x)

raw.scripts:
> scripts
bump = do prop $1 count=1
mkrule = rule when tag:$1 do tag add=seen
report = do create Done kind=note title="report $today" text="made by a script"
inner = do tag $1 add=inner-was-here
outer = run inner $1; do tag $1 add=outer-was-here
